text: TechGnomo V1 is live. The workshop is open.
ClearMoneyPath is coming in 3 weeks. A pay-cycle planner. Not on a store, and not for sale.
We fixed a bug that was apparently convinced rent should be paid twice. It has been dealt with. Bills were being counted twice when reserving money. Each bill’s pro-rata share is now reserved once.
The coming-soon page went up on techgnomo.com. It counted down to Monday, 9:00 AM Brisbane.
We retired the old portfolio and the old TechGnomo OS. The public site counted down to Monday, 9:00 AM.
